verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a workflow/background-task platform, so a public template library is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no library of starter workflow templates. The 'prompt templates' feature covers versioning AI prompts in code, and 'Skills' are instruction sets for AI assistants; both are adjacent features, not reusable workflow templates.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
